name: TPC-H orders and customer geography
description: Synthetic benchmark order data, joined to customer, nation and region. One source row per order. Historical sample data, not current real-world sales.
licence_note: Reference Snowflake's shared sample data in your own account; no data copy is distributed in this repository. Review provider terms before redistribution.
joins: LEFT JOIN {database}.{schema}.CUSTOMER c ON o.O_CUSTKEY = c.C_CUSTKEY
LEFT JOIN {database}.{schema}.NATION n ON c.C_NATIONKEY = n.N_NATIONKEY
LEFT JOIN {database}.{schema}.REGION r ON n.N_REGIONKEY = r.R_REGIONKEY

total_order_value.description: Sum of order total prices; not profit or a separately defined revenue measure. Currency is unspecified.
total_order_value.label: Total order value

average_order_value.description: Average order total price; currency unspecified
average_order_value.label: Average order value

customer_count.description: Distinct customers with orders, not all customers in CUSTOMER
customer_count.label: Customers with orders

region.description: Customer region, uppercase: AFRICA, AMERICA, ASIA, EUROPE, MIDDLE EAST

segment.description: Customer segment, uppercase: AUTOMOBILE, BUILDING, FURNITURE, HOUSEHOLD, MACHINERY

order_date.description: Order date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; use explicit boundaries for years

limitations: Only order-level aggregates and configured dimensions/filters are supported in this version.
Customer counts include only customers with orders; geography means customer geography.
Order value has unspecified currency and is not labelled revenue or profit.
Date coverage is historical; do not assume the dataset contains the current year.

Top-N results are a selected ranking, not all groups. Supported multi-step modes: scalar comparison/percentage change, share of total, and above-population-average groups. Forecasts, raw records, arbitrary multi-query chains and conversational follow-ups are unsupported.
planning_notes: Counting orders -> order_count; total order value -> total_order_value; average order value -> average_order_value; distinct customers WITH orders -> customer_count. All customers is unsupported. Revenue, sales, performance and best are ambiguous: ask for clarification, never silently use total_order_value. Product/line-item analysis is unsupported on this order dataset. Nation, region, segment and priority values are uppercase. For a single year use order_year eq [1995] with integer 1995, no grouping unless requested. Date ranges use order_date. Example count plan: {"status":"query","message":"Count orders.","metrics":["order_count"],"dimensions":[],"filters":[],"sort":[],"limit":20}.

analysis_examples.question: Compare average order value in 1998 against 1997 including percent change.
What share of all orders have customer nation Japan?
